The noise miss is probably bias noise, not M1. The PMOS load mirrors the 0.6 µA diode branch about 30×, so M4/M5 thermal and flicker noise lands on vout amplified. Referred to the input at 1 MHz, that is roughly 190 fA, which explains most of the excess. Also, the 1.98 V power bound fails: 28.7 µA × 1.98 V ≈ 57 µA·V > 53 µW.

Fixes:
- Add an RC filter (2 MΩ, 5 pF, pole near 16 kHz) on the PMOS gate to strip bias noise at 1 MHz.
- Cap the bounds on I1 and k4 so power stays ≤ 53 µW at 1.98 V.
- Add the filtered bias-noise term to the noise model.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (15.0e-6, 11e-6, 15.5e-6),  # gain-stage current (power-limited at 1.98 V)
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.4, 2.0),
    "Rf":    (460e3, 420e3, 600e3),
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid2": (7.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "k4":    (0.08, 0.04, 0.1),          # IREF -> PMOS diode branch ratio
    "Rfil":  (2e6, 0.5e6, 5e6),          # bias noise filter resistor
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1, Rf = p["I1"], p["Rf"]
    i4 = p["k4"] * iref
    Cfil = 5e-12

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=m1.vgs)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs

    m3 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    m3 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, i4, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["Lp"], i4, vds=1.0)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["Lp"], i4, vds=m5.vgs)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=vdd - vout_dc)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M3", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M5", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.R("RFIL", "pb", "pg", p["Rfil"])
    n.C("CFIL", "pg", "vdd", Cfil)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)

    gout = m1.gds + m2.gds + 1.0 / Rf
    A0 = m1.gm / gout
    zt = Rf * A0 / (1 + A0)
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cout = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd
    Cf = m1.cgd
    f = np.logspace(4, 9, 4000); s = 2j * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    Av = -(m1.gm - s * Cf) / (m1.gds + m2.gds + s * Cout + Yf)
    Z = -Av / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 - Av))
    mag = np.abs(Z)
    z0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else 1e9

    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.0
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    # bias mirror noise (M4+M5) scaled by I1/i4, attenuated by RC filter
    ib2 = 4 * kT * 0.8 * (m4.gm + m5.gm) * (I1 / i4)**2
    atten2 = 1.0 / (1.0 + (w * p["Rfil"] * Cfil)**2)
    iout2 = 4 * kT * 0.8 * (m1.gm + m2.gm) + ib2 * atten2
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + iout2 / m1.gm**2 * ((1.0 / Rf)**2 + (w * (Cin + Cf))**2)
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = 1.98 * (iref + i4 + I1)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}
```
